questions.question: What is the error code for Mǎ Bù (Horse Stance)?
What are the deduction points for Mǎ Bù (Horse Stance)?
questions.answer: Deductions are applied when: 1) Thighs not horizontal, 2) The distance between the inner portions of the two feet is narrower than the performer's shoulder width, 3) Knee or knees buckling inwards, 4) Heel or heels raised off the ground, 5) Toes of foot or feet pointing outward 45 degrees or more.
